hypotheses.name: surface_accounting_plus_stronger_instruction
hypotheses.support: no new evidence concept and the smallest prompt
hypotheses.counter_evidence: G5.28 already instructed the model to split different applicability or evidence owners, yet one mixed surface was merged; the validator accepts both the lossy and split variants
hypotheses.cheapest_test: validate the frozen 12-domain candidate and a disposable 13-domain split over the same official surface reference

hypotheses.name: semantic_obligation_units
hypotheses.support: an explicit bounded checklist makes omission observable without prescribing domain IDs
hypotheses.counter_evidence: sentence, paragraph or field atomization would become a form mirror and maintenance taxonomy
hypotheses.cheapest_test: represent only decision-significant meanings in five heterogeneous official cases
hypotheses.observed_result: the mixed surface needs two units; coherent, mandatory and elective aggregates do not need field-level atoms

hypotheses.name: split_only_on_independent_applicability_or_evidence_policy
hypotheses.support: directly explains the G5.28 failure and preserves aggregate components when scope is coupled
hypotheses.counter_evidence: policy equality alone cannot prove that a proposed aggregate component is coherent
hypotheses.cheapest_test: apply the rule to coherent occurrence, mandatory aggregate, mixed policy, elective aggregate and component-owner pressure cases
hypotheses.observed_result: all five cases receive a stable decision without XML or paragraph atomization; component coherence remains a separate review gate

hypotheses.name: post_hoc_derived_deterministic_audit_without_obligations
hypotheses.support: keeps the model input and official evidence unchanged
hypotheses.counter_evidence: code cannot infer missing legal meanings from free text without a tax ontology or hardcoded rules; an LLM critic is not deterministic authority
hypotheses.cheapest_test: ask what input lets code distinguish the two G5.28 variants
hypotheses.observed_result: surface IDs and candidate text contain no closed expected meaning set

hypotheses.name: reference_preserving_obligation_accounting
hypotheses.support: authoritative meanings remain in reviewed evidence and the model only groups exact refs
hypotheses.counter_evidence: the evidence package must itself receive a completeness review
hypotheses.cheapest_test: exact-once reference accounting plus closed policy compatibility over the discriminating cases
hypotheses.observed_result: good grouping passes; lost obligation and mixed-policy grouping fail deterministically

hypotheses.name: model_self_declares_covered_submeanings
hypotheses.counter_evidence: the same model can omit a meaning from both the domain and its self-declared checklist
hypotheses.cheapest_test: remove one self-declared meaning and inspect available deterministic inputs
hypotheses.observed_result: no upstream expected set remains to detect the omission

hypotheses.name: expected_domain_partition_answer_key
hypotheses.support: makes coverage and grouping trivially checkable
hypotheses.counter_evidence: leaks the answer and destroys the independent authoring proof
hypotheses.cheapest_test: compare the supplied keys with the claimed independent output
hypotheses.observed_result: the author becomes a copier or renamer

hypotheses.name: sentence_field_or_xsd_atom_graph
hypotheses.counter_evidence: creates target-layout atoms, relationships and maintenance graph unrelated to root applicability
hypotheses.cheapest_test: apply the boundary to title, deduction calculations and repeated target fields
hypotheses.observed_result: unit count follows document layout rather than independent scope decisions

hypotheses.name: two_model_consensus_or_critic
hypotheses.support: can expose authoring misses without manual answer keys
hypotheses.counter_evidence: agreement reduces risk but does not create deterministic completeness or authority
hypotheses.cheapest_test: consider a shared omission by author and critic
hypotheses.observed_result: no exact closed set exists for terminal validation

discriminating_cases.official_pattern: domestic taxable income plus source, kind and tax-agent facts
discriminating_cases.component_pressure: details are internal values of one source-income family

discriminating_cases.official_pattern: filing instance, taxpayer identity/status and signer authorization
discriminating_cases.component_pressure: package subcomponents may differ but none is independently not applicable

discriminating_cases.official_pattern: professional activity income and civil-contract or author professional deduction claim
discriminating_cases.component_pressure: independent typed owners and independent scope outcomes

discriminating_cases.official_pattern: standard, social, investment and long-term-savings deduction claims plus calculation details
discriminating_cases.component_pressure: one aggregate deduction-claim family can retain internal variants

discriminating_cases.official_pattern: income-group tax base and tax settlement
discriminating_cases.component_pressure: one non-empty aggregate with bounded group subcomponents

semantic_coverage_principle: Keep official meanings together only while they can share one applicability decision, one closed evidence policy and one coherent aggregate component completeness boundary; otherwise split the authoring evidence into separate obligations.
deterministic_validation: every trusted obligation is referenced by exactly one candidate root domain
unknown, duplicate and uncovered obligation references fail closed
every candidate domain contains at least one obligation
all obligations grouped into one domain have one identical closed applicability policy
domain policy, official evidence refs and semantic meanings are compiled from obligation refs rather than trusted from model repetition
every official surface is backed by at least one obligation and every obligation has official evidence
component contracts remain exact inventory refs or honest gaps
target layout, executable rules and runtime workflow remain forbidden
publication_review_residual: whether same-policy obligations form one understandable applicability question
whether one aggregate typed component family is coherent
whether the reviewed obligation evidence itself fully reflects official requirements

future_clean_trial.model_output: domain groups over exact obligation refs plus expected component families

next_boundary: authoring-only obligation evidence and validator revision followed by a new independent G5.28 trial; G5.29 remains forbidden
